surface_name: Archdiocese of St. Louis — Office of Archives and Records (knowledge-base finding aids, archstl.capacity.com; same content mirrored at resources.archstl.org)
enumeration_notes: Complete published school-holdings inventory. The archives' 'Archival Materials' article states: 'Finding aids are posted online as they are created. Please contact the office to discuss materials not listed here.' — i.e. every published school/parish/agency finding aid appears as a named item on the Archives folder's nine articles; there is no deeper per-school index online. Items below are the full set of school-relevant collections found across the Schools and Seminaries, Parishes, and Agencies articles (other articles cover bishops, clergy, newspapers — not schools). The archives' own generic statement: it 'holds the records from closed archdiocesan elementary and high schools, including transcripts, yearbooks, photographs, etc. The extent of materials varies widely for each school.' — so real per-school holdings exist but are only visible through a records request, not the public index.
